english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for speaking softly so nearby people can barely hear.
Use this when the mumbling is mainly too quiet to hear, rather than poorly articulated.

examples.english: I whisper in the library because I don't want to disturb anyone.
examples.traditional: 我喺圖書館入面細聲講，唔想嘈到其他人。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 jap6 min6 sai3 seng1 gong2 m4 soeng2 cou4 dou2 kei4 taa1 jan4

examples.english: You mumble so quietly that I can't hear you.
examples.traditional: 你細聲講到咁，我點聽得到呀？
examples.jyutping: nei5 sai3 seng1 gong2 dou3 gam3 ngo5 dim2 teng1 dak1 dou2 aa3
